text:
owen: Heads-up - weird billing/ledger case from support: a streamed request caused an external toolcall to be partially executed, client retried mid-stream, and the external partner shows two charges. Ledger shows a provisional, then a negative adjustment, then a confirmed charge. Support confused.
tara: partial executed? can you paste the trace?
owen: gist: 1) client opens stream -> we call external enrichment tool as soon as first chunk arrives (toolcall starts), 2) network hiccup mid-stream causes client to reconnect and resend, 3) router routes retry to fallback model, 4) receiving shard executes enrichment again. Partner shows two charges because first call completed on partner side before our ledger finalized provisional.
mike: do we charge partners synchronously? I thought toolcalls were fire-and-forget and we only mark provisional until ledger confirms.
billing-bot: LOG billing: provisional_charge(id=pc_a1f, session=ow-11, tokens=420, external_charge_ref=ext_993)
billing-bot: LOG billing: adjustment(id=adj_b2, session=ow-11, amount=-0.05, reason=partial_reconcile)
billing-bot: LOG billing: confirmed_charge(id=cc_c3d, session=ow-11, tokens=418, external_charge_ref=ext_994)
console-bot: UI: ledger rows show pc_a1f, adj_b2, cc_c3d. no clear mapped dedupe_id; appears as three separate events.
tara: ohhh the negative adjustment is our attempt to reconcile token mismatch, not a refund. product want a clear timeline.
sre: technical root: we issue external enrichment as soon as the first chunk arrives to keep latency low. that makes the external system the source of truth for charges. if the enrichment completes before we finish streaming and write final ledger state, retries can cause duplicates.
product: UX impact: customers see confusing negative line items and sometimes different quota buckets because retry targeted a higher-tier model. this looks like billing bugs.
mike: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) mark external_charge_ref on provisional and surface external partner id in console so ops can map partner charges. 2) auto-open ops ticket when we detect a matching external charge within TTL. 3) visually group provisional/adjustment/confirmed rows by session in the console.
tara: long-term: two main engineering options: A) make external toolcalls idempotent on our side by providing a server-issued dedupe token (we send dedupe_id with the client of the external call and partner honors it), B) change flow to a two-phase model for side-effecting toolcalls: reserve -> commit (reserve is cheap hold/authorization with partner, commit actually charges), C) delay external calls until stream finalizes (bad for latency).
product: product opinion: A is preferred if partners support idempotency; B is ideal but partner-dependent and adds complexity. we can't degrade latency for all customers.
sre: also need to consider quota attribution: if retry lands on different model variant, quotas differ. if dedupe token present, ledger and quota assignment should match original bucket even if final execution used fallback model (or at least reconcile).
ownen: short-term plan I propose: 1) console: add grouping pill "streaming-toolcall group" with timeline + external_charge_ref visible and a "Request refund / partner dispute" action, 2) telemetry: emit metric external_duplicate_rate_by_partner+route, 3) engineering: add server-side dedupe token header X-Tool-Dedupe for immediate PR to external enrichment clients (best-effort; partner adoption TBD).
mike: agree. also add a small heuristic: if we see provisional + confirmed within 2m with same session and same tool name but different token counts, auto-link them as probable match in UI (not automatic refund).
billing-bot: NOTE billing: will add external_charge_ref to provisional writes and accept dedupe_id when present.
console-bot: UI owners: will prototype the grouped timeline and the "partner-charge" badge.
product: policy question: do we auto-refund partner double-charges? we should not until ops verifies partner logs. but we can present an expedited dispute flow.
sre: acceptance criteria for dedupe header rollout: partner support for idempotent dedupe header for at least one major partner, no >0.5% P99 regression. add canary 5% of toolcall traffic.
tara: I'll create a short runbook for support: how to interpret negative adjustments, how to gather external_charge_ref, and steps to open partner dispute.
ownen: filed INF-3777 with traces, sample logs, and suggested console mock. tagging billing, routing, devex, and product. set P2.
product: follow-up: add to PRD a section about streaming toolcalls atomicity and recommended partner contracts (idempotency header).
mike: add dashboards: external_duplicate_rate_by_partner; top offending partners first. alert if >0.2% per day.
console-bot: UI TODO: show external_charge_ref as link to ops ticket prefill.
ownen: thanks everyone. short-term: UI grouping + support runbook + telemetry. medium-term: dedupe header and partner outreach. :thumbsup:
